title: Duplicate corporate accounts
question: Which account records describe the same company, and which merge candidates need a steward?
story: {accounts} account records sit in {rings} duplicate clusters; {central} of them are the strongest matches.
questions: Which cluster holds the most duplicate records?
Which matches need a data steward before merging?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, n.node, n.community, n.centrality, n.metric FROM main.master.account_dedup_out AS o JOIN main.master.account_dedup_out__nodes AS n ON n.node = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: links
datasets.sql: SELECT e.src, e.dst, e.weight, a.community AS src_community, b.community AS dst_community FROM main.master.account_dedup_out__edges AS e JOIN main.master.account_dedup_out__nodes AS a ON a.node = e.src JOIN main.master.account_dedup_out__nodes AS b ON b.node = e.dst

datasets.name: nodes
datasets.sql: SELECT n.node, n.label, n.community, n.centrality, n.metric FROM main.master.account_dedup_out__nodes AS n
